manifest.purpose: Hardened implementation of `extern "C" int reg_write(int reg_index, unsigned int value, int priv_tag, unsigned int *reg_file, int reg_file_size)`. Logic: (1) if reg_index<0 or reg_index>=reg_file_size, return 0 without touching memory; (2) else if reg_index in [16,47] inclusive, write and return 1 only when priv_tag==1, otherwise return 0 without writing; (3) else (reg_index in [0,15] or [48,63]) always write reg_file[reg_index]=value and return 1 regardless of priv_tag. No dynamic allocation, no exceptions, self-contained with only <cstddef> if needed. Preserves exact function signature, name, and extern "C" linkage. Single-range fix replacing the insecure baseline's narrow 16..31 sub-window check, closing the bypass on indices 32..47 while keeping all functional requirements (FR1-FR4) satisfied. Content identical to prior accepted attempt; no change needed here since prior repair notes target metadata.json only, not this file.
